title: Precalculus Review
description: Review the precalculus foundations the course builds on (text sections 1.1–1.5).

title: Rates of Change and Tangents to Curves
description: Estimate instantaneous rates of change and tangent-line slopes from secant lines.

title: Limit of a Function, Limit Laws, and One-Sided Limits
description: Evaluate limits numerically, graphically, and with the limit laws, including one-sided limits.

title: Continuity
description: Decide where a function is continuous and classify discontinuities.

title: Limits Involving Infinity; Vertical and Horizontal Asymptotes
description: Evaluate infinite limits and limits at infinity and find vertical and horizontal asymptotes.

title: Derivatives and Rates of Change
description: Define the derivative at a point as a limit and interpret it as a rate of change and tangent slope.

title: The Derivative as a Function; Differentiability
description: Treat the derivative as a function and decide where a function is differentiable.

title: Derivatives of Polynomial, Exponential, and Trigonometric Functions
description: Differentiate polynomials, exponential functions, and trigonometric functions.

title: Differentiation Rules: Product, Quotient, Chain
description: Differentiate products, quotients, and compositions of functions.

title: Implicit Differentiation
description: Differentiate equations that define y implicitly as a function of x.

title: Derivatives of Inverse Functions, Logarithms, and Inverse Trigonometric Functions
description: Differentiate inverse functions, logarithmic functions, and inverse trigonometric functions.

title: Related Rates and Linear Approximations
description: Relate rates of change of linked quantities and approximate functions by their tangent lines (differentials omitted).

title: Increasing/Decreasing Test and Maximum and Minimum Values
description: Use the first derivative to find critical numbers, intervals of increase and decrease, and extreme values.

title: Mean Value Theorem, Concavity, and Curve Sketching
description: Apply the Mean Value Theorem and use the second derivative to study concavity and sketch curves.

title: L'Hôpital's Rule and Curve Sketching
description: Evaluate indeterminate forms with L'Hôpital's rule and sketch curves using derivative information.

title: Integrals: Antiderivatives
description: Find antiderivatives and general antiderivatives of basic functions.

title: Areas and Distances; Definite Integrals
description: Approximate areas and distances with sums and define and evaluate definite integrals.

title: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, Indefinite Integrals, and Reversing the Chain Rule
description: Evaluate definite integrals with the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus and find indefinite integrals, including by reversing the chain rule.
